before: A composition after a space at the end of a line was clipped out of sight, and a remote edit could repaint over a composition.
after: Composed text shows while it is composed, the page waits for the composition to end before it shows a remote edit, and the composed edit commits onto the current text.
reason: Only paint timing and the local readback change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
